title: WHAT IF YOUR SHOWER HAD A FORECAST?

segments.line: That's how people shower every day.
What if your shower had a weather forecast? You
check it before you get in. You
look at the forecast. You pick the safe time. You get in relaxed. While your neighbor shivers from the cold. But
the truth: water at sixty degrees. Burns skin in three seconds. And worse when a neighbor opens a tap in
the building. Then a man in
a suit opens one. The forecast
So who will turn on your tap?
